parameters.query: START TRANSACTION; INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, title, body, data) SELECT fi.user_id, 'TOURNAMENT', LEFT(CONCAT(f.name, ': registration is open'), 120), 'Registration is open on MyPaltan. Open the Tournaments tab to register your team.', JSON_OBJECT('featured_slug', f.slug) FROM featured_interest fi JOIN featured_tournaments f ON f.slug = fi.slug WHERE f.status = 'REGISTRATION_OPEN' AND f.is_active = 1; DELETE fi FROM featured_interest fi JOIN featured_tournaments f ON f.slug = fi.slug WHERE f.status = 'REGISTRATION_OPEN' AND f.is_active = 1; COMMIT
